title: Geologic Map of the Bonneau Quadrangle, Berkeley County, South Carolina
citation: Doar, W.R., III, Willoughby, R.H., and Clendenin, C.W., 2010, Geologic Map of the Bonneau Quadrangle, Berkeley County, South Carolina: South Carolina Geological Survey Open-File Report OFR-178, map scale 1:24,000.
notes: Single OCR'd map sheet; map face is OCR noise. OCR misreads: 'QHiw' read as QHfw; 'Pid' read as QPld; 'Thickness is | to 15 feet' read as 1 (inferred); eolian symbol 'QPlide' not recorded; section-only unit printed 'Unknonwn'. Section A-A' read from page-image tiles: holes 8-223, 8-226, 8-244, 8-228, 8-217, 8-211, 8-214 with land-surface and contact elevations read off the section's own scale (feet relative to sea level; inferred, about +/-1 ft). Deeper units in the eastern half are separated by queried dashed contacts; only units labelled in or beside a hole recorded. Uppermost elevations (57, 75, 95 ft) and the Ten Mile Hill terrace maximum elevation (35 ft) recorded as unit tops with no datum printed. Pamlico terrace margin elevations (above 17 ft seaward, below 25 ft landward) are terrace margins, not unit tops. Dorchester Scarp, contact and drill hole symbol from the legend only. SUBSURFACE: none beyond the recorded values.
